title: Japan Is Getting Its First Disney Cruise Ship
paragraphs: Disney fans in Japan will soon have a new way to enjoy the magic of Disney: on a cruise ship.

In October 2026, at a ceremony in Tokyo, Disney and the Japanese company Oriental Land announced the name of Japan's first Disney cruise ship. It will be called the Disney Imagination, and it will start sailing from Tokyo in spring 2029. Oriental Land is the company that runs Tokyo Disney Resort, and it will run the cruise business under license from Disney.
The ship will be very large. It will weigh about 140,000 tons and have 1,250 rooms for guests. It will be able to carry 4,000 passengers, and about 1,500 people will work on it.

According to Oriental Land, the ship will mainly make short trips from the Tokyo International Cruise Terminal. The company has also said that the cruises will leave from Tokyo and return there without stopping at other ports. Guests will be able to enjoy entertainment, food and services connected to the Disney brand on board.
The back of the ship will show Ariel, the main character from the movie The Little Mermaid, together with Sebastian and other sea characters. In the picture, Ariel is writing the ship's name.

Natacha Rafalski, who leads Disney's cruise and travel business, said that the ship would give Japanese guests new ways to experience Disney. The ship will be part of Disney's plans to grow its theme parks and cruise business. In 2024, Disney said it would spend about $60 billion on these plans over 10 years. Several new Disney ships are being built, and the Disney Imagination will be the first one to be based in Japan all year.
However, more information about the ship, such as the activities on board and the prices of the cruises, will be announced later.
